errors.description: sample_word_q is a multi-bit value produced in audio_clk and sampled directly in bus_clk without a bundled-data handshake or hold guarantee.
sample_strobe_pulse_q is a one-cycle audio_clk pulse consumed directly in bus_clk, so the event can be missed or sampled metastably.
sample_strobe_toggle_q reconverges with a one-sample bus_clk history, allowing metastability or double-counting in bus_event_o.
gain_mode_sync_q receives independently synchronized bits from encoded control vector gain_mode_q before decoding in bus_clk, so transient illegal modes can be observed.
audio_rst_n is used as data inside bus_clk logic, so reset deassertion can asynchronously change destination state.
dsp_snapshot_q combines audio_clk payload state with bus_clk status state in dsp_clk without a cross-domain snapshot protocol.
